# fastapi-bedrock

> Production-ready FastAPI + Domain-Driven Design cookiecutter template: async SQLModel, JWT auth, Temporal workflows, transactional outbox events, OpenTelemetry — composed feature by feature.

fastapi-bedrock is a Cookiecutter template for production-ready FastAPI services organised as Domain-Driven Design vertical slices. Generated projects ship with async SQLModel/SQLAlchemy 2.0 on PostgreSQL, Alembic migrations, JWT auth with refresh-token rotation, structlog JSON logging, Ruff, strict mypy, pytest with testcontainers, and optional per-flag modules: Docker, GitHub Actions CI, rate limiting, Sentry, Temporal durable workflows, Redis (cache + transactional outbox events), OpenTelemetry observability and a resilient HTTP client. It is not related to Amazon Bedrock.

- [Recipes](https://mohandoz.github.io/fastapi-bedrock/recipes/index.md): Post-generation integration guides shipped with every project
- [Upgrading with cruft](https://mohandoz.github.io/fastapi-bedrock/upgrading/index.md): Pulling template updates into generated projects with cruft
